summary: This RFC defines one-way packet loss metrics that describe loss episodes, meaning maximal runs of consecutively lost probe packets. Applications are sensitive not only to average loss rate but to how the losses are distributed, which the earlier loss metric did not capture.

eli5.summary: Losing ten packets one at a time is different from losing ten in a row. This defines ways to measure runs of lost packets, not just the total.

questions: how to measure bursty packet loss
